answer: Put DAO participation proof at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. Faking 654 identities means 654 fresh proofs and 60168 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. A fable of doubt is healthy, a river of proof is required, and a mesa of patience is the price of a clean panel. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
